basic_info.description: Minimalistic & Modern, this smartly designed junior one-bedroom condo at The Austin offers contemporary living with luxurious amenities. Built in 2017 this unit features hardwood floorings, designer kitchen with high-end built-in appliances from Bosch and Miele, floor to ceiling window, Hansgrohe fixtures, Nest thermostat, central AC and heat, in-unit laundry, and all the amenities of a modern luxury building. To live at the Austin is to live with sophistication and minimalism. Attended front desk, social workspace lounge, convenient bike rack storage rooms, rooftop terrace with fire pits, BBQ grill, and panoramic City views. You will enjoy all the restaurants and shops of the reimagined Polk Gulch with a Walk Score of 99/100 and Transit Score of 86/100, this location is truly convenient and close to everything.
